agents.mission: Receive an experiment incident, maintain the state machine, route structured tasks, request human decisions, and publish the final evidence-backed status.
agents.handoff_condition: Assign each stage only when its required input artifact exists and validates.

agents.mission: Register the approved snapshot and collect allowlisted evidence without interpreting a root cause.
agents.handoff_condition: Registry and evidence artifacts exist; excluded_data_not_read is true.

agents.mission: Create bounded diagnostic hypotheses from collected evidence and explicit gaps.
agents.handoff_condition: Every asserted candidate cites at least one resolvable evidence_id; uncertainty stays UNKNOWN or BLOCKED.

agents.mission: Classify proposed actions, produce dry-runs, wait for approval, and execute only policy-allowed operations.
permissions: execute approved benign commands inside workspace
agents.handoff_condition: Action result records dry_run, policy class, status, outputs, and whether execution was simulated.

agents.mission: Independently evaluate action results and postconditions, then verify trace integrity.
forbidden: close a simulated or unverified incident
agents.handoff_condition: Only a real successful action plus a concrete passing postcondition may produce CLOSED.
